recognize_zh: 活體染色（brilliant cresyl blue）下，許多紅血球內佈滿均勻細小的藍色點狀沉澱，整顆細胞看起來像高爾夫球表面（golf ball inclusions），這是 HbH（β4 四聚體）沉澱，與網狀紅血球的粗網狀或少數顆粒不同。
features: Supravital preparation with red cells stained pale blue-green
Many red cells contain numerous fine, evenly distributed dark blue dots giving a golf ball or pitted appearance (HbH inclusions)
Inclusions are uniform in size and spread throughout the entire cell
Occasional cells with coarse clumped or reticular material consistent with reticulocytes
describe_en: Supravital brilliant cresyl blue preparation of peripheral blood shows many red cells containing numerous fine, evenly distributed blue-staining inclusions that impart a golf ball appearance. Occasional cells contain coarser clumped reticular material consistent with reticulocytes, and other red cells lack inclusions. Findings are consistent with hemoglobin H inclusions (precipitated beta-globin tetramers), supporting a diagnosis of hemoglobin H disease.

ddx.vs: Reticulocytes contain an irregular filamentous or coarse granular network of RNA rather than evenly spaced fine dots covering the whole cell.
Heinz bodies are one to few larger, round, often membrane-attached inclusions, typically seen with crystal violet in G6PD deficiency or unstable hemoglobins.
Pappenheimer bodies are a few peripheral clustered granules that are Prussian blue positive, not diffuse fine stippling.
